FIELD GUIDE

How to play
Fill and isolate every cup within 0.08 with full channel fronts and the competing siphon closed. Radius determines capillary rise and conductance; dry entry barriers and advancing/receding thresholds depend on wetting history.
Every physics interval advances only through its named native control; inspect the actual state and public targets between intervals. These are simplified game models, not engineering predictions.
Complete all three authored studies for a finite campaign. Unsafe committed actions or exhausted physical/time allowances lose; Reset challenge restores this study and Restart game restores the campaign.

Select channel, gate, base pressure, finite Prime pulse, competing siphon, Advance 0.5 s, Seal. Use Tab+Enter/Space or mobile touch on native controls; sliders support keyboard arrows and touch.

Endless review

Generate bounded pore radii and cup bands 0. 55–0. 73 across parallel lift/entry-barrier/siphon networks. Advancing/receding capillary pressures, priming history, finite source and isolation determine retained delivery.
